IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, July 30, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is moving fast on serious work. Ermco's got **$54.75/hr** top scale pushing Google's Mooresville data center and the Lilly Lebanon facility with temperature control specs. That's the highest pay on the board right now, and book depth sits at ~137 hands against 41 calls — meaning Book 1 is genuinely thin. Google outdoor new construction means overtime is real; bring your OSHA 10.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** has locked down the Micron ID1 PLA job with four contractors splitting 57 calls. Scale's **$45.33/hr** but the per diem is **$170/day x7 if eligible** — non-taxed, full week. That's **$1,190 weekly PD** on top of wages. 60/60/50 schedules mean you're working. Book's at ~116, so there's room to land.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is running hot on Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge data center: 112 calls total, **$44.80/hr**, **$100/day non-taxed PD Monday-Friday, $150 Saturdays/Sundays**, 6-10s, GPS radius 100+ miles. Book depth only ~150 hands — this is a tight board with incentive money stacked on wage. Hunt Electric's also pulling 10 on the Air Base at the same scale.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** shows 48 calls spread across EMPS, Potomac Testing, and multiple NoVA data centers; all standard 8s Monday-Friday with NETA and MOP certifications required. Book's soft at ~143 hands, but the work is steady maintenance and acceptance testing — no overtime explosions, but stable.

**LU-405 Cedar Rapids, IA** has CST hammering 50 Inside JW calls on EWD Data Center running (6) 10s from 7 AM. Book's ~130 hands on 35 total calls. OSHA 10/30 is mandatory; background checks standard.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is solid baseline: **$40/hr** across Inglett & Stubbs, Whitehead, Miller Electrical on QTS Fayette and Wellstar Paulding. Book's clear at ~294 hands chasing 43 calls.

Data center construction is eating every available hand — the mega-projects (Polaris, Micron, Google, Port Washington) are the only boards with real incentive stack and per diem leverage.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, July 30, 2026**

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is running the tightest show on the board right now — 25 calls, 116 hands deep, all feeding the Micron ID1 PLA mega-job. Quality Electric, Prime Controls, VECA, and EC Electric are pulling **$45.33/hr** across inside work, but the real money is the **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible), which pushes total package north of $67/day for eligible hands. 4-10s to 5-8s depending on the shop; solid ramp work.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — 21 calls stacked on Parsons and Hunt at **$44.80/hr** for the Polaris Forge Data Center build in Harwood. Inside JW roles running 6-10s with **$100/day non-taxed per diem** (100+ mile GPS radius) and weekend incentive bumps ($150 Sat/Sun). That's clean money for data center infrastructure in a compressed schedule.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** — 8 calls but lean board (85 hands). Summit Line and B&D Industries posting **$55/hr** on project work requiring NM State JIW License EE98J; Rosendin's at **$40/hr** base plus **$15 incentive** for hitting 90% of 60-hour weeks. All OT double time on Summit's call — restoration or new build heavy.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** — 10 calls, 55 hands. Lawson Electric's DNN4 Data Center first-shift inside JW work (6/10 call, hire-in Wednesday 9am) competes with Day & Zimmermann's Watts Bar Nuclear gig (TVA clearance required, MODS call). Solid infrastructure pull across data and nuclear generation.

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** — 46 calls, 140 hands, but **top scale shows $0.00** (data gap). New River's distribution rebuilds dominate: 40 journeyman lineman, **$125/day per diem** nights stayed, **$125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s, Class A CDL required. Distro work sustaining the local.

Data center and renewable infrastructure (Polaris, Micron, DNN4) are pulling the biggest hands right now — PLA work with locked scales and per diem juice is where the tramps are stacking.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, July 30, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is running hot with 18 calls and 61 hands needed — biggest board of the day. BCS Mechanical dominates the Sego Project with 15 journeyman pipefitters and 13 plumbers all starting Aug 3 on 4-10s, 6 AM–4:30 PM with OT built in. DSI's QTS data center gig in Eagle Mountain pays **$10.00 over scale** on a mixed 5-8/5-10 rotation. Book depth is real here; move fast if you're flexible on the West Valley commute.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has 15 calls hunting 42 hands across three states. Kiewit's Fort St. Vrain Powerhouse job hits **industrial wage plus 15% shift differential** with per diem at $65/day — that's serious money for power-plant work. US Eng. Metalworks wants SS-fitting specialists (10% over scale) and Broadcom needs high-purity tube-bending fitters. This is data-center and industrial process piping territory; Denver's book is clearing fast.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** shows 21 calls but only 30 hands deep — **tightest ratio on the board**. Charter and Apollo both need orbital welders and BIM detailers on Intel's Ronler Acres campuses. Specialty tool-install and detailing work; not traditional pipe-chasing but union scale holds.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** has 12 hands on MAP's Holly Frontier Sinclair Refinery shutdown — day shift welders and fitters with DISA required. PMI's Ellsworth AFB job pays **$100/day per diem** for military-base maintenance work across South Dakota.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** stacks 7 calls with fab-shop and Cenovus refinery work paying **$125/day per diem** on pipeline and data-center jobs. Combo welders and pipefitters with current DISA clear fast here.

Industrial maintenance shutdowns and data-center buildouts are pulling hands from the coasts to the interior — refinery and fab work is the play right now.
